title: Start a tomato bed log
body: Give each bed a name. Record the date, recent rain, irrigation and the location of each soil reading. Use the log to discuss changes with your local extension officer.

title: Compare cabbage beds
body: Record observations from two clearly marked spots. Note where each reading was taken so you can return to the same spot on the next visit.

title: Record the local name for morogo
body: Use the name growers use for the leafy vegetable in that bed and record the identified species if known. Bring both names when asking an extension officer for crop-specific guidance.

title: Log rain and watering separately
body: Write down the last rain and the last time you watered each plot. Keep those notes beside the soil reading so you can review them together.
